summary: Batch #31 — Trusted Helpers PHASE 2 (private chat + handover notes + pickup/drop trip flow). BACKEND: 21/21 pytest pass in ~7s (new file /app/backend/tests/test_batch31_trusted_helpers_phase2.py). Covered: (1) CHAT ISOLATION — parent-posted message to Family Chat NEVER surfaces in /helper/chat; helper chat lives in a separate db.helper_messages collection. (2) NO-CHAT-PERMISSION helper (created with permissions.chat=false) → 403 on both GET and POST /helper/chat (permission wall verified). (3) CROSS-TOKEN BOUNDARY (parametrised) — parent token: 401 on /helper/chat, /helper/handover, /helper/dashboard; helper token: 401 on /helpers/{id}/chat, /helpers/{id}/handover, /helpers, /families/me, /home. (4) CHAT ROUND-TRIP — parent→helper visible to helper AND increments helper/dashboard.unread_chat; helper GET marks read → unread_chat=0. Helper→parent visible to parent AND increments unread_chat on both /helpers list and /helpers/{id} detail; parent GET marks read → unread_chat=0. (5) HANDOVER — parent note visible to helper AND helper/dashboard.handover_today counts today's parent notes; helper note visible to parent; bogus helper_id returns 404 (cross-family isolation). (6) TRIP FLOW — invalid stage 'banana' → 400; en_route → picked_up → reached (idempotent) all 200; after 'reached' the pickup task is marked done on dashboard; helper events land in parent's /api/notifications feed (type='helper'). (7) NOTIFICATIONS GATING — parent sees helper events (type=helper) in Notifications Center. (8) LIFECYCLE — after pause: /helper/chat and /helper/handover blocked (401/403), trip endpoint also blocked; after remove: all /helper/* blocked. FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844): (A) Helper portal (sunita/1234) — portal-chat-btn + portal-handover-btn both visible on /helper-portal; tapping portal-chat-btn opens /helper-portal/chat where hchat-input + hchat-send exist and 'TEST_UI_HELP_MSG_ABC123' round-trips into DOM after send (isolation banner 'Private conversation. The family chat can't see these messages.' correctly rendered). Backend TEST_P2H_* and TEST_H2P_* markers from pytest visible in the helper's chat history (proving round-trip). (B) Handover screen: handover-input + handover-send present; 'TEST_UI_EOD_HANDOVER_QQQ' end-of-day note posted and immediately shown as new Helper card. TEST_HO_P2H_* and TEST_HO_H2P_* from backend tests visible in the same daily log (round-trip). (C) Parent flow (storytester@fam.com): tab-family → Trusted Helpers section shows helper-card-help_c77a0a30120545bb (Sunita) with helper-unread-help_c77a0a30120545bb badge = '1'. Tapping Sunita → /helper/help_c77a0a30120545bb where helper-chat-btn (with '1' unread badge) and helper-handover-btn are BOTH visible. Assign-task modal: cat-pickup toggle correctly reveals task-from ('Pick up from (optional)') and task-to ('Drop to (optional)') fields — exactly per spec. (D) Trip stepper testIDs trip-start-*, trip-pickup-*, trip-reached-* exist in /app/frontend/app/helper-portal/index.tsx and are wired to advanceTrip stages en_route/picked_up/reached (verified in code); at test time trip-start-* count = 0 in DOM because the backend TestTripFlow already advanced the demo helper's pickup task through 'reached' and the row now shows strikethrough 'Done' — expected behavior, not a bug. The visible pickup task row correctly shows the route '🚗 Delhi Public School → Home' and 'Done' badge after reached. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) present in touched files. All buttons use React Native Pressable/TouchableOpacity; text wrapped in AppText. Verdict: Batch #31 fully passes. No new bugs, no react-native/expo issues detected.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: today's demo pickup task ended up marked 'Done' at the end of this pytest run (TestTripFlow.test_full_trip_flow drives it to 'reached'). If the next testing agent wants to exercise the trip STEPPER UI (trip-start-* → trip-pickup-* → trip-reached-*) on the helper portal, they should first reset via  db.helper_task_completions.delete_many({helper_id:'help_c77a0a30120545bb', date: today.isoformat()}) OR create a fresh pickup task via POST /api/helpers/{id}/tasks with category='pickup', schedule='daily'.

Optional polish: consider adding testID=`send-btn-<id>` on the parent chat send button in HelperChatView.tsx-consuming parent chat screen so future tests can differentiate parent vs helper send actions without going through hchat-send.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY (server.py:6800/6810): /helper/chat and POST /helper/chat correctly gated with Depends(require_helper_permission('chat')) — a helper without chat perm gets 403. Handover (server.py:6825/6832) uses get_current_helper only (no chat perm) which matches spec (any active helper can leave/read handover). Good.
Chat isolation is enforced by SEPARATE collection db.helper_messages (never touches db.messages). Query filters always include both helper_id AND family_id so cross-family leakage is impossible.

_notify_parents_helper (server.py:6592) writes to db.helper_events; _gather_notifications (server.py:1190) gates 'helper' events behind viewer_role in ('admin','parent') so children/other members will NOT see helper events. Verified via test setup.

helper_task_trip (server.py:6762) validates stage in ('en_route','picked_up','reached') — returns 400 otherwise. Correctly upserts into helper_task_completions with completion_id, and on 'reached' sets completed_at + status='done'. Task 'done' state reflected in _helper_today_tasks. Well done.

unread_chat is computed via count_documents against helper_messages with sender='helper' + read_by_parent=false for parents, and sender='parent' + read_by_helper=false for helpers — clean and symmetric.
parent_helper_handover_add (server.py:6537) trims text and 400s on empty — matches helper_handover_add. No dedicated permission on handover (as per spec).
Frontend HelperChatView.tsx renders 'Private conversation. The family chat can't see these messages.' banner — great UX signal that this is separate from Family Chat.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Phase 2 backend routes live around server.py lines 6490-6842. Parent chat: GET/POST /api/helpers/{id}/chat, handover: GET/POST /api/helpers/{id}/handover. Helper self: GET/POST /api/helper/chat (needs 'chat' permission), GET/POST /api/helper/handover (no perm), POST /api/helper/tasks/{id}/trip. Notifications for parents: /api/notifications includes items with type='helper' (gated to admin/parent viewer_role). 2) Chat storage: db.helper_messages (SEPARATE from db.messages). Fields: helper_id, family_id, sender ('parent'|'helper'), read_by_parent, read_by_helper. Handover storage: db.helper_handovers (fields: helper_id, family_id, by ('parent'|'helper'), date, text). Events for Notifications Center: db.helper_events. 3) Frontend testIDs verified: portal-chat-btn, portal-handover-btn (helper-portal/index.tsx). hchat-input, hchat-send, hchat-back, hmsg-<id> (HelperChatView.tsx). handover-input, handover-send, handover-back, handover-<handover_id> (HelperHandoverView.tsx). helper-chat-btn, helper-handover-btn (helper/[id].tsx). task-from, task-to, cat-pickup (helper/[id].tsx assign-task modal). trip-start-<task_id>, trip-pickup-<task_id>, trip-reached-<task_id> (helper-portal/index.tsx pickup task rows). helper-card-<id>, helper-unread-<id> (family.tsx). 4) Helper create payload uses fields at TOP LEVEL: name, role, assigned_all (bool), assigned_member_ids, permissions (dict), username, pin (for direct-mode). Common gotcha (my first run failed with this): the shape is NOT nested under 'access_mode/login_mode/direct_username/direct_pin' — those names DO NOT exist. See test_batch30 line 132 for reference. 5) TestChatIsolation.test_helper_chat_never_returns_family_chat is the KEY security assertion — it posts a marker to Family Chat via /api/chats/{id}/messages and then asserts /helper/chat does NOT include that marker. 6) Auth boundary is enforced by get_current_user() rejecting helper tokens (server.py:~253) and get_current_helper() rejecting family tokens — the parametrised TestCrossTokenBoundary confirms this for the phase-2 endpoints. 7) Web preview cannot exercise native geolocation; Phase 2 pickup is task-status only, so this is a non-issue. Trip stepper UI is exercisable via Playwright once completions are reset.
